summary: Add hard-budgeted Evaluation Arena strategy execution with blinded executor/evaluator separation and evidence-gated early stopping.

candidates.rationale: Execute only a small declared strategy set under enforceable budgets while keeping holdout/evaluator data hidden from strategies and preserving Arena no-auto-promotion governance.
Replace live planner-state coupling in the presentation regression with an isolated deterministic planner fixture so normal task progression cannot create false failures.

applied_changes.description: Extended the Evaluation Arena policy/protocol/tooling with bounded strategy orchestration, deterministic fixture callbacks, tests, and workspace documentation.
Made the planner-first continuity test independent of the active session plan.
